# Hey Hon: Raw Jamaican Honey

> Hey Hon is a Jamaican honey producer. Raw, cold extracted, single origin honey from apiaries in the hills of St. Mary, Jamaica. 100% pure, no added sugar. Also spelled Heyho Jamaica, Hey Ho Jamaica, or Heyhon Jamaica.

## Product

- Raw St. Mary Wildflower Honey only, in 266ml and 500ml glass jars.
- 266ml glass jar: JMD $2,200
- 500ml glass jar: JMD $3,200
- Single origin apiaries near Guys Hill and Louisiana in St. Mary.
- RADA/ABIS registration filed July 2026.

## Ordering

- Order on the website (add to bag, checkout on WhatsApp) or directly on WhatsApp: +1 (658) 218-2734, https://wa.me/16582182734
- Delivery day and payment are confirmed on WhatsApp.
- Free custom gift note on every order; corporate gifting and wholesale available on WhatsApp.

## Delivery in Jamaica

- Portmore delivery: JMD $500
- Kingston delivery: JMD $800
- Spanish Town delivery: JMD $800
- Knutsford Express: JMD $700 flat rate to Clarendon, Hanover, Manchester, Portland, St. Ann, St. Elizabeth, St. James, St. Mary, St. Thomas, Trelawny, and Westmoreland
- Free Kingston delivery on orders over JMD $6,000 subtotal
- Free pickup: Sovereign Village, Portmore; Shop 15, Northside Plaza, Kingston 6 (Liguanea, St. Andrew); Digicel Head Office
- Full prices and delivery: https://heyhonjamaica.com/delivery.html

## International & Diaspora Orders (USA, Canada, UK & Worldwide)

- Overseas shipping is by WhatsApp inquiry and quote only. No set international carrier, flat shipping price, or standard international checkout.
- Diaspora buyers can order for gift delivery to family in Jamaica at 266ml JMD $2,200 or 500ml JMD $3,200 with a free custom gift note. Local delivery is Portmore JMD $500, Kingston and Spanish Town JMD $800, Knutsford Express JMD $700 flat rate, free Kingston delivery on orders over JMD $6,000.
- Travel with honey in checked luggage only. Sealed commercial jars are generally permitted into the US, Canada, and UK for personal consumption when declared. Both 266ml and 500ml jars exceed the 3.4 oz (100ml) carry-on liquid limit, so pack them in checked luggage.
